package.name: bluerov_control_bt_nodes
package.description: BlueROV-specific Behavior Tree leaf nodes for reuse with Kyubic's bt_executor (behavior_tree package). Phase 2: GoToDepth/GoToBlackboardTarget (movement), CheckPingerFound/CheckBuoyDetected (detection), CheckRosBoolParam (generic debug-flag condition), LoadMissionParams (mission yaml to blackboard) -- covers all 17 states of the former bluerov_control flow.py FSM.
